description: This file defines an enum `TellerStatus` representing different states of a teller in the system, including associated values and utility methods for status checks.

classes.name: TellerStatus
classes.description: Enum representing various states of a teller, such as invalid, pending, active, inactive, and closed, with associated integer values and string codes.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer status value to the corresponding `TellerStatus` enum constant.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if the current `TellerStatus` matches the specified state.

methods.name: isPending
methods.description: Returns true if the status is PENDING.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns true if the status is ACTIVE.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Returns true if the status is CLOSED.

methods.name: isInactive
methods.description: Returns true if the status is INACTIVE.
